title: Rules of Racing — supplementary entry and fee
note: Current Rules state that a supplementary entry under Rule 75 is a confirmation of entry and that all stakes for the race are included in the supplementary entry fee. Use for British procedure; do not project timing or fee structure globally.

title: General Instructions Section 2 — Stakes / Closing Dates / Supplementary Entries
note: BHA General Instructions specify when selected early-closing Group/Grade races may provide supplementary entries and cap the cost as a percentage of prize fund. Use as GB operational corroboration.

title: 海外競馬英和辞典 — 牧場、厩舎
note: JRA overseas racing terminology lists stable and stable area in the farm/stable category and maps the labels into Japanese racing usage. Facility form and management structure remain jurisdiction-specific.

title: Minimum Welfare Guidelines for Thoroughbred Breeding — Appendix 1 Definitions
note: Version 1.1 (July 2025) explicitly defines Covering as a stallion mating with a mare by physical mounting and insemination. Use for Thoroughbred-breeding semantics, not as a universal rule for every equine breeding system.
